verdict.rationale: Google Drive is an API-backed SaaS product, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a sandbox, test tenant, or isolated non-production mode. Related controls, such as per-file OAuth scopes and sharing permissions, limit access but are not sandbox isolation, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
